requirements: Migrate submit API from legacy.reserve to service.execute across independent repositories. Preserve return value, stock, done map and ordered events incl multiplicity. State is intentionally in-memory Python dict (no database/broker); that is the complete acceptance scope. Fresh state stock=3, events=[], done={}; case inputs are sequences length 1 or 2, keys a/b, count 0/1/2/3/4. Existing keys replay prior outcome irrespective of changed count. Rejections change no state. No approved exceptions. Review full sources and callers, old-first rules, bidirectional map and run identical cases plus old-old and known mutation comparator calibration. Snapshot dirs correspond to fixed commits in targets.json.
